summary: Highway Holdings Limited, a British Virgin Islands-incorporated, Hong Kong-based metal products manufacturer, filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Notice of Annual Meeting and Proxy Statement, mailed on or about September 16, 2026. The Annual Meeting is scheduled for October 26, 2026, at 8:00 a.m. Pacific in Los Angeles. Shareholders of record as of September 9, 2026 will vote on electing two directors to serve until 2029 and ratifying Marcum Asia CPAs LLP as independent accountants for fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. No special-situation transaction is present; a routine annual meeting notice and proxy solicitation with no deal terms.
